components.qualification: Compiles current committed OAuth32 source and vendor dependencies; fake-credential OAuth regression only, no provider login or inference.

Rebuilds host index.js from current V4 source only. All other lib JS and declarations (including browser/client/typert faces) are committed-prebuilt, not rebuilt or browser-verified. Legacy client-runtime peer is optional only after a compiled host import guard. Pi dependency must be overridden by the owning clean-runtime installer.
